overview:
Gupta Media Expert Network is a Boston-based specialist network focused exclusively on media, entertainment, and digital marketing. Founded in 2004, the company combines expert consultations with brand analytics capabilities, serving investors and corporate clients who need deep understanding of media industry dynamics, advertising effectiveness, and consumer brand performance.

With over 20 years of media industry expertise, Gupta Media has built a curated network of 20,000+ professionals across traditional media, digital platforms, advertising agencies, and consumer brands.
